verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a first-party infrastructure agent. Users describe tasks in plain English and Neo handles dependencies, executes changes and monitors outcomes; the docs say users can delegate infrastructure work to Pulumi Agents, including through the MCP server. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Neo's delegation workflow, approval and control details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Tell Neo what you need in plain English. It handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically.
